text:
maya: Noticed an uptick in SSE reconnects for route /v1/stream after the routing-policy roll. Console shows small bursts of tokens and many short sessions (2-8s).
otto: Is this the new per-tenant fairness routing we rolled yesterday?
maya: Yes, route-by-load. Mostly EU tenants on shard-7.
leena: Quick Qs: (1) WS or SSE? (2) proxy logs show close codes?
maya: SSE. Proxy logs show `probe -> client halfclose` followed by immediate client reconnects. Example conn: sha7-cc9.
infra-bot: ALERT: tenant=t-100 reconnect_rate=210/m at 1844443390
otto: We intentionally expose a shorter idle timeout on load-balanced shards to reclaim sockets. Seems clients treat probe/halfclose as terminal and reconnect immediately.
leena: Two potential fixes: change proxy probe to emit a non-terminal control event, or change SDK to tolerate a probe (do not reconnect on probe-like frames).
maya: Both require rollout. Short-term mitigation idea: soften routing policy so high-quota tenants are excluded from aggressive reclaim. Pseudoflag: `routing.reclaim.exclude_quota_pct=0.7`.
console-dev: I can add a dashboard widget comparing `reconnect.count` vs `probe.sent` per-tenant, and an annotation when the reclaim policy changed. That should speed debugging for CS.
sre-oncall: Immediate stopgap: add a server-side debounce that suppresses billing open events if a close->open happens within 10s and matches same client_id. That prevents duplicate billing noise.
billing-bot: BILLING_ALERT: duplicate_open_detected tenant=t-100 count=48 at 1844443402
leena: Careful with debounce: we mustn't mask real reconnects after outages. Maybe require a resume token or same session id to dedupe.
otto: Agreed. Let's require same session token and delta<10s to suppress open-billing. Config: `billing.open_debounce_ms=10000` + `require_session_match=true`.
maya: Who can flip a canary for shard-7? I can open a deploy if infra approves.
console-dev: Also request UX change: show an "expected reclaim events" hint in route summary when the reclaim policy is enabled so ops don't file support tickets.
sre-oncall: I'll implement the billing debounce as a quick patch and enable only for shard-7 for 20m. Then we'll observe billing deltas.
leena: Followups: (A) probe->controlframe RFC for proxy team (B) SDK tolerance doc for client teams (C) routing policy flag to exclude high-quota tenants (D) console panel + annotation (E) billing debounce canary.
infra-bot: FLAG_CHANGE: billing.open_debounce_ms=10000 enabled for shard=7 at 1844443430 by sre-oncall
maya: Canary running. Early signal: reconnects for t-100 down ~65% and duplicate billing events dropped.
billing-bot: METRIC: billing.open_suppressed tenant=t-100 count=36 at 1844443458
console-dev: Dashboard panel added to canary console and an annotation pinned to the flag flip.
otto: If stable 30m, plan a slow ramp and push a proxy probe semantic change in next sprint.
leena: Also add a small console UX tooltip on the route explaining "reclaim policy may trigger short probes" + link to runbook. That will reduce support noise.
maya: Thanks all. I'll monitor and update in 20m. :thumbsup:
